tiles.title: Workflow Executions
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "temporal.workflow.id") AS workflow_executions
FROM $traces_dataset
WHERE "temporal.workflow.type" IS NOT NULL AND "temporal.status" = 'started'

tiles.title: Completed Workflows
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "temporal.workflow.id") AS completed_workflows
FROM $traces_dataset
WHERE "temporal.workflow.type" IS NOT NULL AND "temporal.status" = 'completed'

tiles.title: Failed Workflows
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "temporal.workflow.id") AS failed_workflows
FROM $traces_dataset
WHERE "temporal.workflow.type" IS NOT NULL AND "temporal.status" = 'failed'

tiles.title: Workflow Success Rate
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT ROUND(
  100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "temporal.status" = 'completed' THEN "temporal.workflow.id" END)
  / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "temporal.status" = 'started' THEN "temporal.workflow.id" END), 0), 2
) AS success_rate_pct
FROM $traces_dataset
WHERE "temporal.workflow.type" IS NOT NULL

tiles.title: Activity Executions
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS activity_executions
FROM $traces_dataset
WHERE "temporal.activity.type" IS NOT NULL AND "temporal.status" = 'started'

tiles.title: Workflow Failure Events
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS failure_events
FROM $traces_dataset
WHERE "temporal.workflow.type" IS NOT NULL AND span_status_code = 2

tiles.title: Workflow Types
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "temporal.workflow.type") AS workflow_types
FROM $traces_dataset
WHERE "temporal.workflow.type" IS NOT NULL

tiles.title: Task Queues
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "temporal.task_queue") AS task_queues
FROM $traces_dataset
WHERE "temporal.task_queue" IS NOT NULL

tiles.title: Workflow Events Over Time
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT date_bin('1 minute', p_timestamp, '1970-01-01T00:00:00Z') AS time_bin,
  "temporal.workflow.type" AS workflow_type,
  "temporal.status" AS status,
  COUNT(*) AS events
FROM $traces_dataset
WHERE "temporal.workflow.type" IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY time_bin, workflow_type, status
ORDER BY time_bin, workflow_type, status

tiles.title: Workflows by Type & Outcome
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT "temporal.workflow.type" AS workflow_type,
  "temporal.status" AS status,
  COUNT(DISTINCT "temporal.workflow.id") AS workflows
FROM $traces_dataset
WHERE "temporal.workflow.type" IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY workflow_type, status
ORDER BY workflow_type, status

tiles.title: Workflow Execution Summary
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT "temporal.workflow.id" AS workflow_id,
  MAX("temporal.workflow.type") AS workflow_type,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "temporal.status" = 'started') AS start_events,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "temporal.status" = 'completed') AS completed_events,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "temporal.status" = 'failed') AS failed_events,
  CASE
    WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "temporal.status" = 'failed') > 0 THEN 'failed'
    WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "temporal.status" = 'completed') > 0 THEN 'completed'
    ELSE 'running'
  END AS outcome,
  MIN(p_timestamp) AS first_seen,
  MAX(p_timestamp) AS last_seen
FROM $traces_dataset
WHERE "temporal.workflow.type" IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY workflow_id
ORDER BY last_seen DESC

tiles.title: Workflow Failures & Retries
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT "temporal.workflow.id" AS workflow_id,
  "temporal.workflow.type" AS workflow_type,
  COUNT(*) AS failure_events,
  MIN(p_timestamp) AS first_failure,
  MAX(p_timestamp) AS latest_failure,
  MAX(COALESCE("error.message", span_status_message)) AS latest_error
FROM $traces_dataset
WHERE "temporal.workflow.type" IS NOT NULL AND "temporal.status" = 'failed'
GROUP BY workflow_id, workflow_type
ORDER BY failure_events DESC, latest_failure DESC

tiles.title: Workflow Event Span Duration
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT "temporal.workflow.type" AS workflow_type,
  "temporal.status" AS status,
  COUNT(*) AS events,
  ROUND(AVG(span_duration_ns / 1000000.0), 4) AS avg_ms,
  ROUND(APPROX_PERCENTILE_CONT(span_duration_ns / 1000000.0, 0.95), 4) AS p95_ms
FROM $traces_dataset
WHERE "temporal.workflow.type" IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY workflow_type, status
ORDER BY p95_ms DESC

tiles.title: Workflow State Transition Log
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT p_timestamp,
  "temporal.workflow.id" AS workflow_id,
  "temporal.workflow.type" AS workflow_type,
  "temporal.status" AS status,
  severity_text,
  body,
  "error.message" AS error
FROM $logs_dataset
WHERE "temporal.workflow.type" IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY p_timestamp DESC
LIMIT 100

tiles.title: Activity Events Over Time
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT date_bin('1 minute', p_timestamp, '1970-01-01T00:00:00Z') AS time_bin,
  "temporal.activity.type" AS activity_type,
  "temporal.status" AS status,
  COUNT(*) AS events
FROM $traces_dataset
WHERE "temporal.activity.type" IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY time_bin, activity_type, status
ORDER BY time_bin, activity_type, status

tiles.title: Activity Outcomes by Type
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT "temporal.activity.type" AS activity_type,
  "temporal.status" AS status,
  COUNT(*) AS events
FROM $traces_dataset
WHERE "temporal.activity.type" IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY activity_type, status
ORDER BY activity_type, status

tiles.title: Activity Summary
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT "temporal.activity.type" AS activity_type,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "temporal.status" = 'started') AS started,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "temporal.status" = 'completed') AS completed,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "temporal.status" = 'failed') AS failed,
  ROUND(AVG(span_duration_ns / 1000000.0), 4) AS avg_event_ms,
  ROUND(APPROX_PERCENTILE_CONT(span_duration_ns / 1000000.0, 0.95), 4) AS p95_event_ms
FROM $traces_dataset
WHERE "temporal.activity.type" IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY activity_type
ORDER BY started DESC

tiles.title: Activity Event Details
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT p_timestamp,
  "temporal.workflow.id" AS workflow_id,
  "temporal.activity.type" AS activity_type,
  "temporal.status" AS status,
  ROUND(span_duration_ns / 1000000.0, 4) AS event_span_ms,
  span_status_description,
  COALESCE("error.message", span_status_message) AS error,
  span_trace_id,
  span_span_id
FROM $traces_dataset
WHERE "temporal.activity.type" IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY p_timestamp DESC
LIMIT 100

tiles.title: Events by Task Queue
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT "temporal.task_queue" AS task_queue,
  "temporal.status" AS status,
  COUNT(*) AS events
FROM $traces_dataset
WHERE "temporal.task_queue" IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY task_queue, status
ORDER BY task_queue, status

tiles.title: Namespace Activity
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT "temporal.namespace" AS namespace,
  CASE WHEN "temporal.workflow.type" IS NOT NULL THEN 'workflow' ELSE 'activity' END AS event_kind,
  COUNT(*) AS events
FROM $traces_dataset
WHERE "temporal.namespace" IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY "temporal.namespace", CASE WHEN "temporal.workflow.type" IS NOT NULL THEN 'workflow' ELSE 'activity' END
ORDER BY namespace, event_kind

tiles.title: Service & SDK Inventory
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT "service.name" AS service,
  "temporal.plugin.sdk" AS temporal_sdk,
  "temporal.plugin.version" AS plugin_version,
  scope_name,
  scope_version,
  COUNT(*) AS events,
  MIN(p_timestamp) AS first_seen,
  MAX(p_timestamp) AS last_seen
FROM $traces_dataset
GROUP BY service, temporal_sdk, plugin_version, scope_name, scope_version
ORDER BY events DESC

tiles.title: Task Queue Inventory
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT "temporal.namespace" AS namespace,
  "temporal.task_queue" AS task_queue,
  COUNT(DISTINCT "temporal.workflow.id") AS workflow_ids,
  COUNT(DISTINCT "temporal.workflow.type") AS workflow_types,
  COUNT(DISTINCT "temporal.activity.type") AS activity_types,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE span_status_code = 2) AS error_events,
  MIN(p_timestamp) AS first_seen,
  MAX(p_timestamp) AS last_seen
FROM $traces_dataset
WHERE "temporal.task_queue" IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY "temporal.namespace", "temporal.task_queue"
ORDER BY workflow_ids DESC

tiles.title: Span Events Over Time
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT date_bin('1 minute', p_timestamp, '1970-01-01T00:00:00Z') AS time_bin,
  CASE WHEN span_status_code = 2 THEN 'error' ELSE 'ok' END AS outcome,
  COUNT(*) AS spans
FROM $traces_dataset
GROUP BY time_bin, outcome
ORDER BY time_bin, outcome

tiles.title: Event Span Duration Over Time
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT date_bin('1 minute', p_timestamp, '1970-01-01T00:00:00Z') AS time_bin,
  ROUND(AVG(span_duration_ns / 1000000.0), 4) AS avg_ms,
  ROUND(APPROX_PERCENTILE_CONT(span_duration_ns / 1000000.0, 0.95), 4) AS p95_ms
FROM $traces_dataset
GROUP BY time_bin
ORDER BY time_bin

tiles.title: Event Span Duration by Operation
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT span_name,
  COUNT(*) AS spans,
  ROUND(AVG(span_duration_ns / 1000000.0), 4) AS avg_ms,
  ROUND(APPROX_PERCENTILE_CONT(span_duration_ns / 1000000.0, 0.50), 4) AS p50_ms,
  ROUND(APPROX_PERCENTILE_CONT(span_duration_ns / 1000000.0, 0.95), 4) AS p95_ms,
  MAX(span_status_description) AS span_status
FROM $traces_dataset
GROUP BY span_name
ORDER BY p95_ms DESC

tiles.title: Span Status by Operation
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT span_name,
  CASE WHEN span_status_code = 2 THEN 'error' ELSE 'ok' END AS outcome,
  COUNT(*) AS spans
FROM $traces_dataset
GROUP BY span_name, outcome
ORDER BY spans DESC

tiles.title: Recent Span Events
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT p_timestamp,
  span_name,
  "temporal.workflow.id" AS workflow_id,
  "temporal.workflow.type" AS workflow_type,
  "temporal.activity.type" AS activity_type,
  "temporal.status" AS temporal_status,
  span_status_description,
  ROUND(span_duration_ns / 1000000.0, 4) AS event_span_ms,
  COALESCE("error.message", span_status_message) AS error,
  span_trace_id,
  span_span_id
FROM $traces_dataset
ORDER BY p_timestamp DESC
LIMIT 100

tiles.title: Logs Over Time
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT date_bin('1 minute', p_timestamp, '1970-01-01T00:00:00Z') AS time_bin,
  COALESCE(severity_text, p_log_category, 'UNSPECIFIED') AS severity,
  COUNT(*) AS records
FROM $logs_dataset
GROUP BY time_bin, severity
ORDER BY time_bin, severity

tiles.title: Log Severity Distribution
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT COALESCE(severity_text, p_log_category, 'UNSPECIFIED') AS severity,
  COUNT(*) AS records
FROM $logs_dataset
GROUP BY severity
ORDER BY records DESC

tiles.title: Error Volume by Workflow Type
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT COALESCE("temporal.workflow.type", 'unknown') AS workflow_type,
  COUNT(*) AS errors
FROM $logs_dataset
WHERE COALESCE(severity_text, p_log_category) IN ('ERROR', 'FATAL')
GROUP BY workflow_type
ORDER BY errors DESC

tiles.title: Temporal Log Event Distribution
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT body AS event,
  "temporal.status" AS status,
  COUNT(*) AS records
FROM $logs_dataset
GROUP BY body, "temporal.status"
ORDER BY records DESC

tiles.title: Error Details
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT p_timestamp,
  severity_text,
  "temporal.workflow.id" AS workflow_id,
  "temporal.workflow.type" AS workflow_type,
  "temporal.status" AS status,
  body,
  "error.message" AS error,
  "temporal.namespace" AS namespace,
  "temporal.task_queue" AS task_queue
FROM $logs_dataset
WHERE COALESCE(severity_text, p_log_category) IN ('ERROR', 'FATAL')
ORDER BY p_timestamp DESC
LIMIT 100

tiles.title: Recent Temporal Logs
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT p_timestamp,
  COALESCE(severity_text, p_log_category) AS severity,
  body,
  "temporal.workflow.id" AS workflow_id,
  "temporal.workflow.type" AS workflow_type,
  "temporal.activity.type" AS activity_type,
  "temporal.status" AS status,
  "temporal.namespace" AS namespace,
  "temporal.task_queue" AS task_queue,
  "service.name" AS service
FROM $logs_dataset
ORDER BY p_timestamp DESC
LIMIT 100

tiles.title: Poll Timeout Rate by Task Type
Temporal Metric Inventory
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT metric_name,
  metric_type,
  metric_unit,
  COUNT(*) AS samples,
  COUNT(DISTINCT __series_hash_u64) AS series,
  MIN(p_timestamp) AS first_seen,
  MAX(p_timestamp) AS last_seen
FROM $metrics_dataset
GROUP BY metric_name, metric_type, metric_unit
ORDER BY samples DESC

tiles.title: Metrics by Service Instance
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT "service.name" AS service,
  "service.instance.id" AS instance,
  COUNT(DISTINCT metric_name) AS metrics,
  COUNT(DISTINCT __series_hash_u64) AS series,
  COUNT(*) AS samples,
  MIN(p_timestamp) AS first_seen,
  MAX(p_timestamp) AS last_seen
FROM $metrics_dataset
WHERE "service.name" IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY "service.name", "service.instance.id"
ORDER BY samples DESC
